text:
Cass: dropped a fresh compare/catalog mock into the board: https://redwood.mock/compare/density-vs-clarity. Two quick asks: (1) how many filter chips to show in compact rows before collapsing into a +N control, (2) final lexicon for performance badges (show p50/p95 on hover only?).
Rana: my vote: show up to 3 chips inline, collapse after that. keeping them separate helps scanning. +N should open a small popover with the full list and be keyboard-focusable.
Evan: For the +N popover please follow the listbox pattern: have role=listbox, focus the first item, and provide aria-label="Active filters". Also make the trigger include aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Miko: Badges: surface a human-first label like "120 ms" and a tiny microtag "typ." or a clock icon. Reserve 'p50/p95' and sample size for the tooltip. Non-technical folks keep asking what p50 means.
Cass: agree on human-first surface copy. We should also standardize the badge lexicon across catalog and compare (otherwise inconsistent scan patterns). Proposal: surface = numeric + unit, qualifier = "typ."; tooltip = "p50: 120 ms; p95: 420 ms; n=1,240".
Rana: UX nit on pinning: modal currently reads "Confirm pin" which is terse. Suggest title: "Pin model version for this project" body: "Pins Version ID: v2024-09-01. If this version is unavailable we'll fall back to a compatible variant." CTA: "Pin version".
Evan: pinned state should be discoverable in the row: left-edge chip "Pinned" with aria-label="Pinned for project" and a keyboard-focusable toggle. Also add an undo snackbar for 6 seconds.
Miko: color/accessibility: don't use color alone for perf states. add up/down chevron icon + color. also ensure capsule contrast >= 4.5:1 for 12px or use bolder weight.
accessibility-bot: Contrast check: element #perf-capsule small-text contrast 3.6:1 against #FF7A7A. Recommendation: darken to #D33E3E (approx) or increase weight to 600. Also: +N popover must trap focus and return focus to trigger on close; provide aria-live="polite" announcements when the list opens, e.g., 'Filters expanded: quantized, short-context'.
Cass: nice. Action items: (1) chips: show 3 then +N with accessible popover; (2) badge lexicon standardize to '120 ms' + microtag 'typ.' with p50/p95/n in tooltip; (3) pin modal copy + Version ID and fallback line; (4) pinned left-chip + keyboard toggle + undo snackbar; (5) fix contrast + add icon for non-color semantics; (6) acceptance criteria for keyboard and screen-reader flows.
Rana: i'll update the spec and add keyboard flows to the ticket.
Evan: i'll draft the aria snippets and paste them in the design file.
Miko: will push Figma update and prototype link by EOD. Cass: adding to next sprint backlog?
Cass: yes please 4cc aiming for eng pickup next sprint. thanks all :white_check_mark:
